text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—The Asahi Hai FS, a showdown to decide 
the Junior Class champion.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If I could stand in a place like this, I 
wonder if my grandfather would be pleased.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...My early days. Back when I couldn't 
handle my inner impulses, and tried to 
force others to submit through sheer 
power."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
When I mistook 'violence' for 'strength' 
and was about to stray from the path, my 
grandfather showed me the truth.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
—Do not let yourself be consumed by the 
flame. Tame the fire, and become its 
master.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Strictly, persistently, loudly. Kindly, 
tenaciously, warmly. ...They were always 
by my side.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Grandpa. Through the martial arts, you 
taught me how to discipline my heart.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To me, carrying a raging flame that 
remained unquenched even through martial 
mastery, you showed the path of a racer.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It gave me a thrilling purpose to live 
for.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To repay that kindness and grow into a 
better version of myself, I set sail today 
on a new journey of training.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"First, I must evaluate the Umamusume who 
might become a worthy rival on my path—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I seeee... So Ardan-san's health really 
is...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um. They mentioned before that they 
might come visit to observe.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
However, the doctor told her not to, so 
she will apparently be resting at her 
family home today...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ardan is incredible! As an umamusume of 
the prestigious Mejiro family, she has 
both the aptitude and the talent.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Still... my body was just too weak...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...There are Umamusume who can run like 
this, and there are Umamusume who can't, 
aren't there?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: T-That's exactly why I have to do my best!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is growing fast, myself included! 
The secret to developing that ability even 
further lies in competition! Which is to 
say, 'anti-static gloves'!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Besides, today is the Asahi Hai FS. I'm 
definitely going to win!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Because this is a race that Maruzen-san 
won, after all. Besides...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm, well... the kind of horse girl who 
never gives up on her dreams.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, when it comes to ability, talent, or 
skills, um, other girls might have more, 
but...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, with all my heart and soul! I'm going 
to make the flower of victory bloom!
